API_AND_APPLICATION_ENTRY.label: API and application entry
API_AND_APPLICATION_ENTRY.limit: An entry point shows how a capability is reached; it says nothing about authorization or traffic.

APPLICATION_ORCHESTRATION.description: Code coordinating two or more application operations or workflows.
APPLICATION_ORCHESTRATION.label: Application orchestration
APPLICATION_ORCHESTRATION.limit: Calls to two or more collaborating classes suggest coordination; the workflow itself is not reconstructed.

BUSINESS_DATA_ACCESS.description: Repositories and persistence operations supporting a capability.
BUSINESS_DATA_ACCESS.label: Business data access
BUSINESS_DATA_ACCESS.limit: Data-access code shows how data is reached; runtime SQL and data ownership are not known.

BUSINESS_LOGIC.label: Business logic
BUSINESS_LOGIC.limit: A service stereotype or a branching method suggests logic; it does not prove which business rule it implements.

BUSINESS_PROCESSING.label: Business processing
BUSINESS_PROCESSING.limit: Detected from code shape only; the business meaning needs review.

BUSINESS_VALIDATION.description: Validation that enforces business rules or domain constraints.
BUSINESS_VALIDATION.label: Business validation
BUSINESS_VALIDATION.limit: A declared constraint does not show that it encodes a business rule or that it is enforced on every path.

DOMAIN_MODEL.label: Domain model
DOMAIN_MODEL.limit: Persistence annotations show a stored record

EXTERNAL_BUSINESS_INTEGRATION.label: External business integration
EXTERNAL_BUSINESS_INTEGRATION.limit: A client API call does not show which business system is behind it.

AUDITABILITY_AND_COMPLIANCE.label: Auditability and compliance
AUDITABILITY_AND_COMPLIANCE.limit: Source patterns do not show regulatory compliance.

AVAILABILITY.label: Availability
AVAILABILITY.limit: Mechanisms present in code do not show achieved availability.

CONFIGURATION.label: Configuration
CONFIGURATION.limit: Configuration files are not retained from a compiled artifact

CROSS_CUTTING_INFRASTRUCTURE.label: Cross-cutting infrastructure
CROSS_CUTTING_INFRASTRUCTURE.limit: The framework type shows a request-pipeline hook; which concern it serves needs its code to be read.

DATA_INTEGRITY.label: Data integrity
DATA_INTEGRITY.limit: An annotation shows intent; transaction behavior and isolation need runtime or test evidence.

EXTENSIBILITY.label: Extensibility
EXTENSIBILITY.limit: An interface with two or more implementations shows a seam

INTERNATIONALIZATION.label: Internationalization
INTERNATIONALIZATION.limit: Locale support does not show that every text is translated.

INTEROPERABILITY.label: Interoperability
INTEROPERABILITY.limit: Client and serialization usage shows a contract exists

MAINTAINABILITY.label: Maintainability
MAINTAINABILITY.limit: Structural measures indicate change cost; they are not defects by themselves.

PERFORMANCE.label: Performance
PERFORMANCE.limit: Structural indicators are not measured performance problems; use the Performance tab for measurements.

PRIVACY_AND_DATA_PROTECTION.label: Privacy and data protection
PRIVACY_AND_DATA_PROTECTION.limit: Only what source or configuration shows is reported; no privacy compliance is claimed.

RELIABILITY.label: Reliability
RELIABILITY.limit: Presence of a mechanism does not show that recovery works.

RESOURCE_MANAGEMENT.label: Resource management
RESOURCE_MANAGEMENT.limit: Resource handling cannot be proven leak-free from bytecode references.

SCALABILITY.label: Scalability
SCALABILITY.limit: Asynchronous or scheduled execution is not proven scalability.

SECURITY.label: Security
SECURITY.limit: Security classes or annotations do not show that the application is secure

TESTABILITY.label: Testability
TESTABILITY.limit: Seams make testing easier; they say nothing about the tests that exist or their coverage.

primary_classifications.FUNCTIONAL: Implements or enforces business behavior (entry points, logic, validation, orchestration).
primary_classifications.FUNCTIONAL_SUPPORT: Supports a capability without implementing its rules (data access, domain model).
primary_classifications.MIXED: Has a detected business responsibility and its own code runs a non-functional concern (it calls or holds the concern API).
primary_classifications.NON_FUNCTIONAL: Implements a technical concern with no business behavior detected.
primary_classifications.UNCERTAIN: No detected evidence establishes a responsibility; any label rests on a name only.

statuses.DETECTED: Established directly by a fact in the bytecode.
statuses.INFERRED: A reasoned reading of one or more facts; not established as a fact.
statuses.UNVERIFIED: Needs runtime, configuration or test evidence that is not available.
